#define filter_dbg(filter, data, format, args...)		\ /* <=== drivers/input/serio/i8042.h:77:86:filter_dbg:4 */ 
	do {							\
		if (!i8042_debug)				\
			break;					\
								\
		if (!filter || i8042_unmask_kbd_data)		\
			dbg("%02x " format, data, ##args);	\
		else						\
			dbg("** " format, ##args);		\
	} while (0)

#define dbg(format, arg...)							\ /* <=== drivers/input/serio/i8042.h:70:75:dbg:2 */ 
	do {									\
		if (i8042_debug)						\
			printk(KERN_DEBUG KBUILD_MODNAME ": [%d] " format,	\
			       (int) (jiffies - i8042_start_time), ##arg);	\
	} while (0)
